# ARCHITECTURE ANCHOR

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <anchorPhase> on 2026-11-02 from [root/ai/] specs -->

Stack: Next.js App Router (TypeScript strict) + Tailwind CSS, hosted on Vercel
Database / auth: none in v1 (Supabase planned later)

Data flow: /content/*.ts (typed constants) → /lib/content.ts helpers → static server components
- Types: /lib/types.ts
- Pages: /app — all statically generated; /musicians/[slug] via generateStaticParams
- Components: /components
- Images: /public/images/{musicians,about,festival}/ via next/image
Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL only
